$comment: QuickCap's tag grammar, as data, read by two test suites in two languages.
The grammar has two implementations and has to: the app reads tags while
the user is still typing, which happens in TypeScript, and the migration
reads them off bytes on disk, which happens in Rust. Two implementations
that drift produce a vault where the tags shown are not the tags stored.
So neither implementation owns the grammar — this file does.
src-tauri/src/utils/tag_grammar.rs both run every case below, and a
disagreement between them is a failing test rather than a support ticket.
Adding a case is how you change the grammar. Changing one should take an
